code:
# Codex: add to ~/.codex/config.toml (the first two lines go above any [table] in the file)
model_provider = "local"
model = "llama3.2"

[model_providers.local]
name = "local gateway"
base_url = "http://localhost:4000/v1"
env_key = "LITELLM_API_KEY"   # Codex reads the key from this variable: export LITELLM_API_KEY=sk-litellm-local
description: Eight lines of TOML configure Codex to use the local gateway: set model_provider to local, model to llama3.2, then define the local provider with base_url and env_key for the API key.

steps.description: The config sets model_provider and model at the top level, then defines a [model_providers.local] table with name, base_url pointing to localhost:4000/v1, and env_key set to LITELLM_API_KEY.
Line 7 shows the base_url uses /v1 suffix; the gateway expects OpenAI-compatible paths.
Line 8 tells Codex to read the key from LITELLM_API_KEY; export LITELLM_API_KEY=sk-litellm-local before launch.

steps.question: What environment variable does Codex read for the API key?
